sprite:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make a production translation proof SPRITE ATLAS for The Stellar Holds, not a concept illustration. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Exactly TWELVE complete isolated dwarf figures in an evenly spaced grid: 4 columns x 3 rows on a 1536x1024 canvas. No text, no labels, no panels, no ground shadows, no props held in hands. Each complete figure fits entirely within its own cell with generous transparent margins. Same figure scale in every cell. Every row shows four idle facing directions: column1 front, column2 right-facing profile, column3 back-right three-quarter, column4 straight back.
Reference1 is the EXISTING IN-GAME style and proportions authority. Copy its WORLD SPRITE simplicity and sturdy compact adult proportions, not portrait detail. References2/3/4 only supply named-character identities. Translate their ornate concept costumes into bold readable shapes. Use thick warm dark contours, broad clean color blocks, 2-3 value shading, very restrained brushwork. No fine filigree, crosshatching, tiny embroidery, pores, noisy weathering, individual hair strands. Faces mature with normal small eyes and strong noses, no anime or chibi. They will render only 62 pixels tall; visual clarity wins. Whole drawn bodies, strong short legs, substantial boots, 3 heads tall, thick necks, two arms and two legs per figure.
ROW1 DAGNA: adult feminine sturdy dwarf, pretty grounded face, warm chestnut loose flowing hair simplified into 5 large locks, warm witty smile, rowan red fitted bodice with modest cream scoop neckline, short cream sleeves exposing forearms, simple cream apron over dark red practical calf-length skirt, broad brown boots, single brass clasp/buckle. No bread basket, no floral embroidery.
ROW2 IVAR: broad older male dwarf, grey swept hair and full long grey beard with one central broad bound braid and two smaller side locks, ochre foreman coat over cream rolled sleeves, dark trousers, broad brown boots, simple belt and one leather pouch. Hands empty, ledger tucked into belt pouch, no hanging lantern (remove clutter for world sprite). Calm warm brow. Exactly two arms.
ROW3 SKARRIN: adult male dwarf, combed-back black hair, intentionally SHORT DENSE FULL BLACK BEARD covering chin/jaw (not shaved), narrow resentful eyes under strong eyebrows, charcoal high-collared survey coat with warm grey front insert, one diagonal brown satchel strap, charcoal trousers, brown boots. Hands empty. Compact powerful dwarf, not a tall human.
Keep all four views of every identity consistent. Clean transparent space between figures. Do not enlarge heads into baby caricatures. No portrait busts on this atlas.

walk: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent game walk-cycle proof atlas: exactly 12 complete isolated figures, THREE rows and FOUR columns, evenly spaced cells on 1536x1024. Reference image is the EXACT approved simplified identity, outfit, proportion and paint style. Preserve Dagna in row1, Ivar row2, Skarrin row3. All figures now face RIGHT in clear SIDE PROFILE. Each row is FOUR DISTINCT sequential WALKING KEYS for its one character, not four identical poses and not different angles. Column1 left leg forward contact/right leg back, column2 left leg bears weight with right knee bent passing forward and right boot visibly lifted, column3 right leg forward contact/left leg back, column4 right leg bears weight with left knee bent passing and left boot visibly lifted. Natural opposed swinging arms. Keep head and torso steady, visible foot separation, same body size and planted ground baseline across row. Dagna's practical calf-length skirt moves subtly with gait and allows visible boots. Coats move subtly. Exactly two arms and two legs, hands empty. Full chin and jaw covered on both men, Ivar long grey full beard with center braid/two short side locks, Skarrin dense SHORT full beard. Same red/cream Dagna, ochre Ivar, charcoal Skarrin color blocks. Broad clean painted shapes and thick contours, minimal trim, 2-3 values, no fine texture. Every whole figure remains completely inside own cell, no cropping, 5 percent gaps. NO labels, text, grids, shadows, background gradients or haze. Genuine transparent background; only characters opaque. Do not put portraits or idle poses on this sheet.
